description: Service accounts should authenticate non-interactively (batch jobs, services, scheduled tasks). An interactive logon (console/RDP/SSO portal) with a service account suggests credential misuse or an attacker operating hands-on-keyboard.

detection.logic_plain_english: Alert on any successful login where the account is flagged as a service account AND the logon type is interactive. Requires the event source to carry both a service-account flag and a logon-type field.

false_positive_notes: Admins occasionally log in interactively with service accounts during initial setup or troubleshooting. Maintain a small allowlist of admin jump hosts, and require a ticket reference for exceptions.
log_source: Authentication logs with logon type (Windows Security 4624 logon types 2/10/11, IdP interactive sign-ins)
name: Service account used for interactive login
